subject: v0.6.2 whole-diff review — REVISE; consolidated severity findings
body:
REVISE at frozen comms 5f286d6632b727b448e92d0c1ec466c6c1e23bdd / env ce9d7947218a6fa06aa1fddf9fa9d6ebeae1551b / wrapper 2df47866bc22cee90b650a18837db5f8edc3b4e5. Full report: C:/Users/Administrator/AppData/Local/Temp/aify-v062-review/REVIEW.md. coverage.json beside it accounts for all 42/14/2 changed paths with exact blob hashes. Your subsequent uncommitted removal fix is outside this verdict.

P1: R1 stop claim still loses between commit and response refetch, including target metadata (actual removal ok:true / controls:[]). R2 registry fallback sends the stored key to a mismatched environment-selected URL, reproduced with synthetic receivers for current and legacy overrides. R3 raw read bypasses secure-store checks: wrong-case file resolves where aify-env refuses, and invalid/oversized credential bytes are accepted. Symlink exploit UNPROVEN: Windows refused the scratch link.

P2: R4 fixed claimer and outbound MCP HTTP owners disagree; actual registered comms_send gets401 without env key while aify-http authenticates. Synthetic env-key control fixes both; not attribution of the historical live401. R5 doctor reports green on500/404, malformed/EACCES configs, ignores HERMES_HOME, and judges unrelated-endpoint clients. R6 YAML comments, prefixed names, empty-with-comment values and wrong-root blocks falsely prove key presence.

Env P2: R7 client resize listener sits below infinite await, never runs (relocated control works). R8 Enter after the new TUI notice enables blind typing without restoring display or invoking real attach. R9 split escapes bypass detection and30s idle expiry releases old cursor controls outside the pane. R10 common emoji make an allegedly80-cell row occupy115 cells; clipping loses styled combining marks. Reproduced against exact sources;185 focused tests still green.

R11/P2 docs: wrapper purity claim still false; prompt docs promise removed resume behavior and absent safety gates; doctor table mistakes warning/unknown for death. P3: stopped resize listener, clipped input-mode indicator, false endpointFor history, conflicting herdr stages.

Direct answers: wait holds no write transaction (independent writer committed during it). Ten sequential exhausted budgets contribute20s plus overhead, not a hard/calibrated deadline. if-signalled is a cheap-query optimization, not proven load-bearing by the empty fixture. Resolve endpoint and secure credential together at a composition boundary shared by HTTP owners; two reads/zero with env key observed, but no cold MCP-discovery acceptance. Operator-only shared/attach guidance is defensible. Auto-answer exists but not feature/safety parity; config authentication and install timing history stay author-reported.

Console: actual resync resets to snapshot10 after live11 paints, keeps lastSeq11, loses11 and drops replay. Buffer the snapshot/delta handoff and compare first divergence before replacing transport. This is a reproduced consumer bug, NOT attribution of the reported live corruption.

Independent focus: Python27, auth105 in10files, env185, dashboard40 all green while adversarial consumers reproduce defects. Removing the credential fallback correctly fails the call-site test (10pass/1fail), so no surviving-mutant claim there. No full five-suite/deployment/fleet certification or tag approval. Detailed file:lines, controls, claim limits, and executable artifacts in the report. Native MCP reply again401; delivered using the existing secure resolver with endpoint matching, no credential/config edits.
